book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Xel wo qayeeng en Yesu wou Pailat
Woyom xel qendu dalus on qandi lek me qou Yesu me la wou Pailat.
Me xel wong qayeeng en e, me neil embei, “Xa xei tambiy tine wo nol wou kwa wei xa Yudayeiw o, me peti xa bei xa se toung takis wou Sisa. De mi neil embei e Kilisi, me e yon king ti.”
Om Pailat teling wou Yesu, “Inyon wa king wei Yudayeiw o?” Yesu neil elox wou, “Ee inyon nambei wang neil on.”
Woyom Pailat neil wou xel lumuki leitata is xel qendu ngandoung on bei, “A se xei sewokeing ti lek tambiy tine.”

Ekom xel luk nikanzek me neil embei, “Tambiy on mi ghavineeng me la danghei danghei nei eivek Yudia, myaxeeng anghei distrik Galili me mi lam a zenz inye is, me mi teyoxe xomaxoneing me zeim xel laleind lek.”
Xel wo qayeeng en Yesu wou Herot
Pailat ngo tine om teling wou xel, “Moux tine inye Galili ti?”
Gyeik ingwei Pailat ngo bei Yesu yon nanghei Galili, woyom wong ela wou Herot en nambei Herot yeiteyei beyeeng danghei tiyon. De gyeik bouk kayon eno Herot toundei Yerusalem.
Gyeik ingwei Herot yei Yesu eno wo xeilala ngandoung, en nambei mi toung ma wou en embei gyei e, en vatiyeiw wei e ngo yo, moxo wounalei bei Yesu e bong lulvako valu me e gyei.
Herot wong telinyeing ngenong wou e. Ekom Yesu se neil qayeeng ti lox wou e.
Xel lumuki leitata yo me putoung wei petieing o toukale inyon, me wong qayeeng en e nikanzek.
Woyom Herot alis e xe xel vevek wong napeing wou Yesu me lukyak lek e woy, om xel qou teimb nimza maseim ti me byex lek e, dom wong e lox me la wou Pailat.
Lek bouk kayon eno Herot aluw Pailat wo gweleeng lek ama. Takwei eno luw mi wo vevek wouma.
Pailat neil embei xel atuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng
Pailat taxe xel lumuki leitata yo me xel gyovaxa me xomaxoneing lam qekuma.

Me moxo neil wou xel bei, “Xam ghe qou tambiy tine me ghe lam wou ay me ghe neimbei mi zeim xel laleind lek bei xel bo vevek wou seyap. Om a wo telinyeing lumama wou e wou xam mamim, ekom a se xei sewokeing ti wou tambiy tine en vatiyeiw wei xam ghe wong qayeeng en e yo.
De Herot is ambei nyon, om wong e loum wou xey. Xam ghe wei, tambiy tine se wong sewokeing ti bei e mey.
Nambei nyon tyek a sesa moxo de woyom na bong e na.”
Ekom moux alis vex dalus poux avyend lekti me neil embei, “Leis tambiy on mey, de wong Barabas lam wou xa.”
Barabas on tambiy wei wong vevek eivek beyeeng ngandoung me leis xel valu mey o, om xel toung e la xeitueing.
Pailat embei bong Yesu na, om neil wou xel dalus no.
Ekom xel di tetulexe wou taxeing me neil embei, “Tuw e lek xax pepeeng! Tuw e lek xax pepeeng!”
Lu yayal eno moxo neil wou xel bei, “Enva? Tambiy tine wong sewokeing vati? A se xei sewokeing ti bei e mey, om tyek a sesa e de na bong e na.”
Ekom xel wo ninkanzek me taxe la xoulekeing bei, Pailat e tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng. Me xel xe taxeing sevunexe Pailat ning qayeeng.
Om Pailat betiwou qayeeng wei xel o me neilteyei bei Yesu e mey.

Moxo wong tambiy tiwei toundei eivek xeitueing en ingwei wong vevek me leis xel valu mey, eno la myayaing, tambiy tiwei xel teling en o. De Pailat betiwou xel xe lalei vineing me wong Yesu wou xel vevek.
Xel tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng

Ka xel vevek qou Yesu me la, eno xel yei tambiy ti lam anghei beyeeng myayaing nei en embei na eivek Yerusalem, moxo lei Simon wei beyeeng Sairini yo. Xel zeimaxoun e me liw xax pepeeng lek e ghandiwek de e qalei me betiwou Yesu.
De xomaxoneing ngenongakes di betiy e, is xel vex ngenong wei laleind pyaxow en e me di wong talot me eng o.
Yesu pekwi ma me neil wou xel bei, “Xam vex wei Yerusalem o, xam seng deeng en a ti, qe xam ghe deeng en xam venaxow de neumyeiw is.
En bouk ti tyek nam gyeik ingwei xam a neimbei, ‘Vex wei mi mouyeeng o, vex wei se wo neu yo me vex wei se di wong luul wou neu eno xel bo xeindlala.’
Woyom moux alis vex tyek

content.text: “‘na neil wou xel lukendu bei, “Xam qepei lek xa!”
me xel qetyei bei, “Xam sevun xa!” ’

content: Gweimbeeng xomaxoneing wong nimaying ne wou ay nambei xax wei nimwis o. Om xam ghe ghok xax wei mupek o om tyek bong ambei nya wou xam loxyus?”
Tambiy yayuw, luw xouing mi wong sewokeing, om xel qou luw me la is Yesu en xel embei na nyeis luw amey is e.
Gyeik xel la tyip nanghei tiyon, xel mi neil embei Lukanzek, nanghei tiyon eno xel tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng, me tambiy nilul yayuw is, nge wou e mema payeiv de nge wou e mema qeinz.
De Yesu neil embei, “Mang, wa semaleeng sewokeing wei xel o, en xel se woulek vati wei xel di wong ne.” De xel vevek di nex qakous dee me pum e xe teimb wouma.
Xel xomaxoneing toukale me di yei e, de xel gyovaxa wo vyend wou Yesu bei, “Moxo mi vind xel ba, de wangwei e Kilisi wei Anutu beyal o, on wong e vind xow.”
Xel vevek wong vyend wou e is ambei nyon. Xel la paviy e me wong wain senyeing wou e.
De xel neil embei, “Wangwei wa king wei xel Yudayeiw o, ond vind xow.”
Lek xax pepeeng pundanghou eno xel byex qayeeng bei, “INYE KING WEI YUDAYEIW O.”
Tambiy nilul yuw wei xel teyu is Yesu, eno nge lukyak lek Yesu, “Wa Kilisi? Ond wa devind xow me uw is.”
Ekom nilul nge neil e, “Wa seng waleeng en Anutu? En wang qalei nimaying teyei lek ambei e?
Uw a qalei myavanei ne la teyei lek en nimaying vati wei uw a wong o. Ekom tambiy moxne se wong sewokeing ti.”
Woyom moxo neil embei, “Yesu, wang bounaleim en ay gyeik ingwei wang nam eivek wa xe tete lalei yo.”
Yesu lewexe wou e bei, “A neil wou wang zonghek, gweimbeeng eno tyek wang na mendei is ay eivek beyeeng nimza wei Anutu yo.”
Yesu mey
Inye nambei seivma evlek eno mapetok ngandoung sevunexe tembuing sapa, me ela teyei lek seivma yal,
en nambei sayeiv siing eno tip, de qaeing wei xel teyu eivek xomek vambuing eno lex ela yuw.
Yesu taxe xoulekeing bei, “Mang, a wong axe laweeng lak eivek wa memam.” Gyeik moxo neil ambei nyon eno puw laweeng wei yus o de mey.
Beyeiv wei xel vevek o eno yei vati wei qandi yo, me sanghoxe Anutu. Me neil embei “Zonghek ayang, tambiy tine nye bombek.”
Gyeik xomaxoneing dalus wei qeku la toukale eno yeimend wou vatiyeiw wei qandi yo, xel laleind wo maying me qatu bambound de lox me la bend.
Ekom Yesu xe xel gweleeng dalus, is xel vex wei betiy e me lam anghei Galili eno xel toukale kwanding me yei vatiyeiw wei qandi yo.
Xel liw Yesu eivek qakous eeng
Tambiy ti lei Yosep, inyon kanzol wei Yudayeiw eno ti, tambiy on nimza me bombek.
Moxo lalei se vind woueing nalei me kwa wei xel kanzol wong on. Moxo lam anghei Yudayeiw xe beyeeng nayak wei Arimatia, de moxo mindei me axe Anutu xe tete lalei.
Yosep la wou Pailat me teling wou e en embei qou Yesu neing.
Woyom moxo la zewax Yesu neing me qou me ouk me loum, de beliv eivek qaeing pus me qou me la liw eivek leiveeng meyeing wei xel kwelexe eivek qakous o. Xel seng ghei liw xelti eivek.
Inyon bouk wei menyexeing wou lulul en Sabat o, de Sabat lam paviy.
Xel vex wei lam anghei Galili is Yesu eno betiy Yosep me la yei leiveeng meyeing wei Yosep liw neing di yeip nambei nya yo.
Woyom xel lox benbend me yeiwou lulul is wel xeimangou yo. De inyon Sabat, om xel toundei lek nambei ingwei Mose xe petieing neil o.

footnotes.text: -17 Xel lupeyei valu wounalei bei qayeeng veweeng toundei is, lek danghei tine. Qayeeng tine eno nambei nye: Vakovek qes titi lek bouk wei Pasova, eno Pailat e mi bong xomaxoneing ti na veil xeitueing.
